commits.message: docs(meta): replace dead meta CLI with Pipeboard MCP as the access path (#161)
commits.author: shalomer

panels.title: Bury the dead Meta CLI
panels.scene: Knight with a shovel digging a small grave for a mossy, crumbling stone labeled 'META CLI'. Villagers weep uncontrollably and toss black roses onto the grave.

bubbles.speaker: Villager
bubbles.text: The ancient Meta CLI has fallen! We are lost in darkness!

bubbles.speaker: Knight
bubbles.text: It broke two years ago. I'm taking it out of the code.

panels.title: Install Pipeboard MCP access path
panels.scene: Knight casually drops a shiny metal pipe labeled 'PIPEBOARD MCP' across a deep canyon. Divine beams of light burst out from the pipe as villagers fall to their knees praying.

bubbles.speaker: Villager
bubbles.text: A HOLY BRIDGE OF PIPES HAS SAVED OUR SOULS!

bubbles.speaker: Knight
bubbles.text: It just connects the two tools.

panels.title: Update documentation (#161)
panels.scene: Knight uses a feather pen to cross out 'meta cli' on a giant town scroll and writes 'Pipeboard MCP'. Confetti cannons explode and a parade of villagers dances behind him.

bubbles.speaker: Villager
bubbles.text: HE REWROTE THE SACRED MAP! THE KINGDOM CAN READ AGAIN!

bubbles.speaker: Knight
bubbles.text: I changed one line in the help file.

panels.title: 1 commit. 1 dead CLI removed. 1 new path opened.
panels.scene: Knight sitting tired on a wooden stool holding a cup of water. In the background, villagers build a giant metal pipe statue while a couple holds up a baby.

bubbles.speaker: Villager
bubbles.text: We named our newborn baby Pipeboard MCP!

bubbles.speaker: Knight
bubbles.text: Please give that child a normal name.
